system.description:
Once per encounter when an enemy makes an Attack of Opportunity against you, as a Reaction you can automatically negate the attack and immediately move up to half your speed. This movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

If you have the Combat Reflexes feat, you may use this Talent a number of times per encounter equal to your Dexterity bonus (minimum 1). You may still only use this Talent once per round.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Rebellion Era Campaign Guide
